newsitem.title: INDIA: India 97/98 crude output forecast at 33-34 mln t.
newsitem.headline: India 97/98 crude output forecast at 33-34 mln t.

text.p: India's crude oil output in 1997/98 (April-March) is forecast at 33-34 million tonnes, the same as the 1996/97 estimate, a senior petroleum ministry official said on Thursday.
"The crude oil output in 1996/97 will be around 33-34 million tonnes. In 1997/98 it is likely to be at the same levels," the official, who did not want to be identified, told Reuters.
India's Oil and Natural Gas Corp and Oil India Ltd jointly produced 35.19 million tonnes of crude oil in 1995/96.
The country's demand for petroleum products is forecast to rise to about 81 million tonnes in the year ending March 31, 1997 from 74.7 million in 1995/96, officials say.
India imported 47.68 million tonnes of crude oil and petroleum products in 1995/96
